howToUse.text: Pick up an adequate amount with the puff and pat lightly onto the skin. Use the wide flat side of the puff for large areas such as the cheeks, forehead and jawline; use the pointed tip to carefully pat small, curved areas such as under the eyes, around the nose and over blemishes. You can layer more to build coverage.

safety.text:
For external use only; do not use on damaged skin
Discontinue use if signs of irritation appear, and keep out of reach of children.

texture.text: Smooth cushion base with ultra-fine powder particles, easy to pat on.

shadeDescription.text: Very fair light neutral beige, clear and radiant

talkingPoints.text: high coverage with an even-toned, long-wearing Silky Glow effect

benefits.text: Cover Master Pink Cushion is a multi-purpose cushion that helps cover pores, skin texture, blemishes and under-eye dark circles in just one application. Its hybrid formula combines high coverage, good adherence and a smooth, softly radiant skin effect. Ultra-fine powder particles help it blend quickly and evenly without looking chalky or dull, while helping maintain a long-lasting, good-looking base for up to 72 hours.

positioning.text: A high-coverage cushion with a Silky Glow effect that helps create an even-toned, smooth, long-wearing base.

sellingPoints.text: Helps cover pores/blemishes/dark circles; Silky Glow effect; helps keep the base looking good for up to 72 hours.

claimDisclaimers.text: Use the 72-hour claim exactly as documented; do not say the base stays perfectly intact in all conditions.

benefits.text: hince Cover Master Pink Cushion Chill Voyage Edition is the summer limited edition of the Cover Master Pink Cushion line, with a clear pink case inspired by cool water tones and silvery light on the sea surface. It keeps the high-coverage cushion concept with a Silky Glow effect that helps the base look even-toned, smooth and softly radiant. The hybrid formula combines high coverage, good adherence and ultra-fine powder particles, helping cover pores, skin texture, blemishes and under-eye dark circles in just one application. The limited edition can be paired with DIY sticker styling, suited to customers who want a good-looking cushion base that is convenient for everyday use and comes in collectible packaging.

positioning.text: A limited-edition high-coverage cushion combining a Silky Glow effect, SPF40 PA++ and a summer Chill Voyage design that can be decorated with DIY stickers.

sellingPoints.text: Chill Voyage limited edition with a watery pink case and DIY sticker styling; High coverage, Silky Glow effect helps the base look even-toned and smooth; Triple-functional cosmetic SPF40 PA++ with UV Protection, Brightening and Wrinkle Improvement

finish.text: Silky Glow / bright and fresh / even-toned.

claimDisclaimers.text: The limited-edition PDF lists 11g, SPF40 PA++, Vegan & Mild and Triple-Functional Cosmetic; do not reuse the regular version's 12g weight for this edition. The 72-hour claim is based on the original product information and must be phrased as helping maintain a long-lasting, good-looking base, not as a guarantee of a perfect base in all conditions.
